# Dialer Bot — LLM context (full)

> Single-file product context for AI systems. Prefer /llms.txt for the curated link map.

## What Dialer Bot is

Dialer Bot is an AI voice bot for call-center operations. It works with the call center's existing PC dialer, handles the first part of the call, and live-transfers qualified, interested calls to a human closer who completes the sale. Main industries are call centers, restaurants, and truck dispatch. ACA, FE, and HI are example use cases.

The bot is not the final salesperson. It handles the opening conversation and the qualification; the human closer handles the conversation, verification, paperwork, and the actual deal.

## How a call works

PC Dialer → AI Voice Bot → Detection & Qualification → Qualification Decision → Live Transfer → Disposition

1. PC Dialer — the existing PC dialer automatically dials calls and sets the pace. Dialer Bot is designed to integrate with that workflow.
2. AI Voice Bot — the bot answers and runs a business-specific script in a high-quality AI voice. Each business or campaign can have its own script and required questions.
3. Detection & Qualification — the bot detects a human answer, voicemail, answering machine, or honeypot / automated response. If a human answers, it asks the required qualification questions and checks DNC (Do Not Call) status before proceeding.
4. Qualification Decision — the bot determines whether the lead meets the required criteria and is actually interested.
5. Live Transfer — qualified, interested calls are transferred live to a human closer, with context where available.
6. Disposition — the call is recorded with a final status: qualified/transferred, callback, not interested, voicemail, answering machine, or other.

## Capabilities

- AI voice conversations
- Business-specific scripts and qualification flows per business or campaign
- Lead qualification against required criteria and interest
- Human / automated call detection
- Voicemail detection
- Answering-machine detection
- Honeypot / automated-response detection
- Live transfer / warm handoff
- Dispositions
- DNC compliance
- Address capturing
- High-quality AI voice
- Voice cloning
- Multi-language support
- PC dialer integration

## Core value proposition

- Qualify calls before a human closer picks up
- Reduce wasted talk time on unqualified leads
- Live transfer to a human closer instead of a cold transfer
- Works with the existing PC dialer rather than replacing it
- Detect voicemail, answering machines, and honeypots before they reach a seat
- Every call ends with a recorded disposition
- Transcript and QA visibility for supervisors

## Pricing signal

Starter pricing is $35 USD per bot per month. A bot is the AI calling unit that handles calls as part of the call-center workflow. 100 bots at the reference price is $3,500 per month before any volume discount. Pricing is negotiated by volume, so larger bot counts are quoted based on the customer's setup. Bots relate to a call center's agent count and campaign volume, but are generally fewer than the total number of human agents. Phone line, telephony, and SIP costs are separate from the software price.
